events.title: The Fall Up Steam Next Fest demo is out now!
events.summary: Hello everyone,Our new, limited-time Steam Next Fest demo is here, and we’re excited to let you loose in the world of Fall Up.Fall Up is a playful, challenging 3D platformer about combining movement abilities, figuring out unusual obstacles, and landing that jump you were absolutely sure was possible.The full game is planned for release in 2026. events.title: Fall Up Demo Now Unavailable
events.summary: Hello everyone,You may have noticed that the Steam demo for Fall Up is no longer available.The demo was created during an earlier stage of development. events.title: Fall Up Launches December 3! Exclusive Full-Build Playtest Opportunity Now Open
events.summary: Hello everyone!Today we are excited to share the news: Fall Up will launch on December 3, 2026, for Steam, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and natively on Nintendo Switch 2!A single playthrough of Fall Up will offer over 20 hours of content. events.title: Happy Lunar new year from Fall Up
events.summary: Fellow mates, From January 27th to February 10th, Fall Up will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at Unicellular Games extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community. As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on Fall Up. events.title: Fall Up time-limited demo available during the Chinese New Year Steam Event!

Exploration - Try to find all the collections, 'Battery' and 'Gems' in the stages. 2.
